about: NewMed Energy - Limited Partnership exploration, development, production, and marketing of natural gas, condensate, and oil in Israel, Jordan and Egypt. The company holds interests in the Leviathan project, which covers an area of 500 square kilometer (km2) located to the west of the shores of Haifa; the Block 12 that covers an area of approximately 386 km2 located in Cyprus; and the Yam Tethys project, located to the west of the shores of Ashkelon.
